subject: Revenue commit clarity call: action log & next owners
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightstream.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Revenue commit clarity call: proposed 3/15 10am PT

Team / Priya —

We had the sync with Brightstream last week and finance flagged a mismatch between the committed ARR in SFDC and the numbers Priya shared in the renewal packet (line items + support add-on). I want to run a short call tomorrow to close the gap and capture a final commit for forecasting. Proposed agenda (20m):

- Quick recon: SFDC committed ARR vs Brightstream packet
- Confirm outstanding procurement/PO timing and approval owner
- Decide any credits or one-time uplift adjustments for FY27
- Capture final commit and next owner for signature

Ben/Naomi: can you pull the three most recent invoices, contract value, and the support add-on delta before the call? Priya: please have your CSM confirm the PO cadence.

If 3/15 10am PT works, I will send the invite and a short pre-read.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, RevOps | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightstream_renewal_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet with itemized changes)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightstream.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue commit clarity call: proposed 3/15 10am PT

Lauren —

I pulled the copies and attached a quick pivot to the Brightstream_renewal_summary.xlsx. Top-level: SFDC shows $1,080,000 committed ARR (net) for the renewal bucket; Brightstream packet lists $1,165,000 (gross) because they included a $120k professional services holdback that wasn't in our renewal seat count. If we treat PS as a one-time professional service, committed ARR should be $1,045,000.

Key ask for the call: Naomi / Finance to confirm whether PS is being recognized as ARR (they expect it to be one-time). If finance says one-time, we need a one-line amendment and to update SFDC before EOD 3/16 to reflect the corrected commit.

Attaching: Brightstream_renewal_summary.xlsx (tab: Ben_pivot)

-Ben

Attachment: Brightstream_renewal_summary.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightstream.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T12:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue commit clarity call: proposed 3/15 10am PT

Thanks Ben — this aligns with what I saw. A couple of notes for the call tomorrow:

- From a recognition perspective, PS is typically one-time professional services and should not inflate ARR. We need the amendment (one-line) to explicitly call PS out as professional services and billed separately.
- If Brightstream pushes to include PS in the commit, we should map the revenue timing (recognized vs invoiced) and then decide whether to include a 12-month amortized view in our internal forecast (but mark it as "at-risk").
- I will bring the latest invoice run (Feb 2027) and the deferred revenue schedule.

Action: assigning myself to prepare a short reconciliation table; will upload to the Drive link and share before the call.

-Naomi
Finance Lead, Revenue Operations
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightstream.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightstream Solutions CSM <csm@brightstream.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue commit clarity call: proposed 3/15 10am PT

Thanks Lauren — 10am PT works for us. Quick clarifications ahead of the call:

- Brightstream intended the $120k PS item as a separate professional services engagement; it is not intended as recurring ARR. The packet included it for visibility.
- PO will be issued the week of 3/22 once internal procurement signs off. Our legal team has one outstanding redline on liability limits; expecting resolution by 3/21.

I'll have our CSM on the call to confirm PO timing. See you at 10.

Best,
Priya
Senior Customer Success Manager, Brightstream Solutions
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightstream.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Revenue commit clarity call: action log & next owners

Team — good call today, short summary and owners:

1) Final committed ARR for forecasting: $1,045,000 net ARR (PS removed). Owner: Ben — update SFDC and attach amendment. Due: 2027-03-16 EOD.
2) Amendment: one-line addendum to explicitly classify $120k as Professional Services (non-ARR). Owner: Legal Ops / David to coordinate with Brightstream legal. Draft to Finance and Sales for sign-off. Due: 2027-03-21.
3) PO timing: Brightstream expects PO week of 3/22. Owner: Priya (Brightstream) / CSM to confirm on 3/18.
4) Forecast treatment: Naomi to mark the $120k as "one-time, at-risk" in the March close. If legal delays push invoicing beyond April, Naomi to flag in the weekly forecast note. Due: 2027-03-16 (initial posting).
5) Escalation if procurement stalls: if PO not issued by 3/25, Lauren to escalate to AM and VP Sales.

Related artifacts: Drive folder with reconciliation table (Naomi uploaded), Ben's pivot (attached), draft PSA addendum (PSA_addendum_v2.pdf). Links: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/BRST-2027-07

Please reply only if any owner needs to change due dates or ownership. I will update the forecasting cadence and mark this in the commit ledger once SFDC is updated.

Thanks all —
Lauren

Attachment: PSA_addendum_v2.pdf
